name: Big Island
blurb: A tropical island sandbox: the author's whole map.
author: Comrade Stinger and Hiyu
attribution: Converted from gm_bigisland, https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=169600867 by Comrade Stinger and Hiyu. Drawn from the map's own geometry with free (CC0) textures and stand-in models, listed in its world pack's credits; the author's textures and models are not carried. The author can have this conversion removed: contact https://github.com/zees-games/playlot-maps/issues.
